title: Pipeline hold file
description: The machine-readable definition of docs/PIPELINE-CONTRACT.md §20 — the hold the watcher sets (scripts/pipeline_hold.py, KIT-515) and only the owner clears. While it exists, nothing that starts work may start. An absent file is no hold; a file that is not a valid hold holds.
$comment: FIELDS ONLY. A hold names a monitor, a word from a closed list, a ticket or `owner/name#N`, and a time. No ticket, comment or pull request text can land in it.

schema.description: The marker. A reader that does not know it holds.

set_at.description: When this file was last written by the watcher.

holds.description: Why new starts are held. Never empty: the file is removed, by the owner, to clear it.

monitor.description: The watcher's monitor that flagged it at level `pause`.

what.description: The finding, as the watcher's own closed word.

ref.description: What it is about: a local date, a ticket id, or `owner/name#N`.

since.description: When this hold was first set. A later pass never moves it.
